summary: Reitar Logtech Holdings filed a Form 6-K disclosing six Regulation S subscription agreements signed October 2, 2026 for a private placement of 2,750,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$2.00 per share, raising US$5,500,000 gross, with five purchasers taking 500,000 shares each and one taking 250,000; all confirmed non-U.S. persons. The board approved the issuance. The filing also notes a completed 25-for-1 Cayman share consolidation and a Nasdaq Staff delisting determination with trading suspended since September 17, 2026, plus a November 2, 2026 EGM for a further 10-for-1 consolidation. Watch the EGM outcome, closing conditions and delisting overhang.
